helpful_moments: Opening tap-guard instruction immediately corresponded to visible target and TARGET DOWN feedback.
Distinct HOLD ROUTE / HOLD APPROACH / HOLD TO RECOVER labels made contextual action discoverable. Recovery checkmarks named the people saved.
Map overview clearly connected current position to Mara with a walking route and described low cover as blocking movement.
Custodian numbered coils, percentages, OFF states, and uplink upload progress clearly exposed objective progress.
Rain, cyan trim, warm reflected lights, station signage and restrained terminal panel formed a coherent atmospheric presentation.
frustrating_moments: Far patrols were tiny at 844x390; world detail and dark gray cover reduced quick target separation.
Threat prompt sits above FIRE and can cover the world; multiple banners, crosshair, route dots, weapon and controls leave limited unobstructed scene.
Offscreen TURN/FIRE or CHARGE cues indicated direction without establishing a safe visible firing target.
Coil II attempt 2 required several bursts through reload and armor; feedback was informative but the correct real-time firing cadence remains uncertain.
Assisted routing did much of traversal. The observed path was usable, but autonomous assistance limited the amount of independent navigation and combat evaluated.

scores.scale: 0 unusable, 5 functional with substantial friction, 7 good with clear limitations, 9 excellent across assessed areas, 10 exceptional. Holistic judgment of observed emulated mobile play only; wins and reported accuracy are not quality grades. Overall is not an arithmetic average.

reasons.overall_mobile: Two coherent complete missions with accessible touch assistance and strong atmosphere, constrained by crowded view, small targets and limited sustained manual combat evidence.
reasons.controls: Two-contact MOVE plus FIRE drag and a scene swipe produced visible movement/turn/target-down feedback. Large anchored controls and tap aim helped; precise unassisted tracking, prolonged physical ergonomics and held rearming remain unassessed.
reasons.gameplay: Recoveries, coil objective and deck hold supplied understandable progression and pressure. Manual patrol engagements and reload correction were observed, but route assistance dominated traversal and short bursts limited combat depth assessment.
reasons.presentation: Strong consistent industrial storm atmosphere, readable spatial silhouettes in close views and polished result panel. Audio unassessed.
reasons.usability: Contextual hold actions, route assistance, recovery checkmarks, map close and fresh start were discoverable and worked in observed use. Several overlapping prompts compete for attention.
reasons.readability: Main objectives, health/ammo and result statistics are clear; distant enemies, smaller signage, compact phase information and overlapping cues are less comfortable at 844x390.
